metadata.title: Gothic Rock Portraiture with Cool Tones

retrievalProfile.description: A moody, high-contrast portrait featuring a subject with voluminous dark curls and a studded leather jacket against a textured blue-lit background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a woman with pale skin and closed eyes, framed by a massive halo of dark, tight curls. She wears a black, heavily studded leather jacket. The lighting is directional, casting deep shadows under the jaw and hair, while the background is a textured, cool-blue stone or brick wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between pale skin and dark, textured hair/clothing
Juxtaposition of soft facial features with hard metal studs
Cool blue background vs. neutral black and white subject tones
Vertical orientation emphasizing the volume of the hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the majority of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pale face and closed eyes serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright face outward to the expansive hair, then down to the detailed texture of the jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners where the blue textured wall is visible.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low color saturation, dominated by blues and blacks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues, blacks, and pale neutrals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with massive, dark, curly hair wearing a black studded leather jacket. Use cool blue lighting on a textured stone wall background. Ensure high contrast and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, elegant serif or a hand-drawn script in a light silver or white to contrast with the dark jacket.

verificationChecks: Is the hair voluminous and dark?
Is the jacket texture clearly studded?
Is the lighting predominantly cool blue?
Are the shadows deep and dramatic?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue background light
Density of the studs on the leather
mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital sharpness; maintain film-like grain
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue light doesn't wash out skin tones
Verify the hair silhouette is expansive
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [80s rock fashion] with [chiaroscuro lighting] and [cool blue palette] to create a [moody music portrait].
